name: Triple complacency-avoidance: greed-band + low-VIX + crowded-funding regime gate (macro-armed)
rationale: Thesis: NOT every confluence is a capitulation buy. This is a risk-ON trend-continuation triple: a constructive crypto crowd (fear_greed in a moderate-greed band via between, NOT euphoria-extreme), a calm equity-vol tape (vix_level low), and a healthy-but-not-blown-out perp funding (funding_rate between a small-positive band = longs paid for carry but not crowded-mania). The macro_regime composite must be CROSSING UP (risk-on igniting) to arm entries — a drifting feature so used only via cross_up, never a raw level. Three risk-on axes confirming is a rarer, higher-quality trend entry than chasing price. Long-only spot. Disconfirmer: must beat (a) macro_regime cross_up ALONE and (b) the subset's buy-and-hold — if either matches, the sentiment/vix gates are decorative; and (c) the fear-side capitulation triple, to show this greed-trend variant is a distinct edge, not a relabeled reversion. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: macro_regime crossing into risk-on with constructive sentiment, calm VIX, and non-crowded funding
